home.headline: El pulso de sus operaciones de alquiler
home.sub: Propiedades, trabajos, tareas, proveedores, facturas y huéspedes en un solo espacio. Cada uno ve su parte, en su idioma.
home.proof_line: Estamos lanzando en Koh Phangan, incorporando a los primeros equipos a mano. Las reseñas aparecerán aquí cuando haya reseñas reales.
home.alt_title: Problemas de la gestión de propiedades
home.alt_1: Envía un trabajo. Hasta que llama, no sabe si alguien lo tomó.
home.alt_2: Los recibos se acumulan como fotos en un hilo. A fin de mes hay que buscarlos otra vez.
home.alt_3: Alguien se va. Los contactos de proveedores y los acuerdos se van con su teléfono.
home.alt_answer: El chat no se va a ninguna parte, y no debe. Pulse Flow entra donde el chat deja de servir: un encargo confirmado, un coste ligado a una propiedad y un historial que se queda en la empresa.
home.card_villas_desc: Una lista para el propietario, el gestor asignado y quien está en el sitio. Detalles, estado, pin en el mapa, fechas de estancia y foto, para que el equipo entienda los inmuebles asignados.
home.card_jobs_desc: Añada los contactos de mantenimiento y resérvelos con una llamada o un mensaje. O invítelos a la app para conveniencia de ambos: el personal podrá aceptar trabajos en la app.
home.card_money_desc: Vea cuánto le cuesta el mantenimiento en un periodo, filtre por categorías, apruebe facturas al pagarlas. Todos los datos se exportan para sus hojas de presupuesto.
home.card_guests_desc: Controle todos los aspectos de la relación con huéspedes: invite a habituales a reservar por la app a tarifa local, comparta las normas. Un depósito con cada deducción, sin malentendidos.
home.lang_title: Un idioma para todo el equipo
home.lang_desc: El gestor escribe el trabajo en inglés, la limpiadora lo lee en tailandés, el propietario lo ve en hebreo. Cada uno elige el idioma una vez en el perfil: trabajos, chat y mensajes llegan automáticamente en su idioma.
home.why_lead: Cada rol tiene su propia pantalla. Abra la que va de usted.
home.audience_owner_desc: Ocupación, trabajo urgente y gasto - sin preguntar a nadie.
home.audience_manager_desc: Arme el día una vez. Entregue el turno con el historial completo.
home.audience_staff_desc: Sus trabajos en el teléfono. Confirme con un toque, envíe recibos desde el sitio.

home.agent_lead: Chatee con el agente en la app, o conéctelo desde Ajustes. Trabaja en su espacio Pulse en vivo: tareas, encargos, propiedades y facturas, sin entregar la base de datos.
home.agent_li_chat: Chatee con el agente dentro de Pulse — pregunte qué está abierto, cree una tarea o un encargo, marque el trabajo como hecho.
home.agent_li1: Cree una clave de conexión en Ajustes, péguela en el agent shell y desconéctela cuando quiera.
home.agent_li2: Lee quién es usted, el equipo, las propiedades con entrada y salida, las tareas abiertas, los trabajos y las facturas.

home.agent_cta: Chatee en la app, o conéctelo en Ajustes → Conectar su agente.
home.agent_safety: El agente nunca obtiene la clave de la base de datos. Solo usa esa conexión personal, limitada al espacio de empresa actual.

home.plan_personal_desc: Una o dos propiedades, lo hace todo usted. Gratis para siempre.
home.plan_company_desc: Tiene un gestor, un limpiador o proveedores. 15 USD / mes por la empresa — 10 plazas incluidas, luego 2 USD por plaza extra. Solo paga el propietario.
home.plan_pro_desc: Añada Pro por 9 USD / mes en Personal o Empresa — Conectar su agente.
home.plan_note: La facturación aún no está activada. Cada cuenta registrada recibe 3 meses de acceso completo — Pro y Conectar su agente incluidos — desde el día en que se inscribe.
home.referral_title: Invite a 5 personas y obtenga un año de funciones de empresa gratis
home.referral_lead: El enlace de referidos está en el perfil. El año gratis se cuenta desde el día en que el sistema de cobro esté activo.
home.faq_q1: Mis limpiadoras no van a usar otra aplicación.
home.faq_a1: No tienen que aprender nada nuevo. Envía un enlace, lo abren en el navegador y queda en el teléfono como cualquier app. Sin descarga, sin cuenta, sin App Store. Ven solo sus trabajos, en su idioma, y confirman con un toque. Si leen WhatsApp, pueden usar esto.
home.faq_q2: Mi gestor ya tiene un sistema. ¿Por qué cambiar?
home.faq_a2: No estarían cambiando: añadirían un lugar donde los trabajos que ya gestionan se vuelven visibles para el resto. El chat se queda. Lo que cambia es que un trabajo tiene estado confirmado, un coste asociado y un registro que no desaparece cuando alguien se va.
home.faq_q3: Todo está en Airbnb y Booking. ¿Esto los sustituye?
home.faq_a3: No. Bookings stay where they are. Pulse Flow is about what happens after the booking: who cleans, what broke, what it cost, and what the guest can see. You can paste each listing’s private calendar export (.ics) from Airbnb or Booking.com into a property to pull reserved nights into the Bookings calendar. That is not a full channel API and does not replace their listings or checkout.
home.faq_a4: Personal es gratis para siempre. Empresa cuesta 15 USD / mes e incluye 10 plazas de equipo; cada plaza extra cuesta 2 USD / mes. Pro añade 9 USD / mes en Personal o Empresa para Conectar su agente. Ahora la facturación no está activa, así que cada cuenta tiene 3 meses de acceso completo — Pro incluido — desde el día en que se registra.

home.alt_closing: Su operación de alquiler, siempre al pulso
home.faq_q5: ¿Tendrán mis huéspedes que hacer algo complicado?
home.faq_a5: No. Les envía un enlace. Lo abren, leen las normas de la casa y ven el saldo de la fianza. Sin descarga, sin cuenta, sin pago a través de la aplicación. Los pagos van directos a usted: la aplicación solo guarda constancia del importe, de las retenciones y del saldo para que ambos lados vean lo mismo.
home.faq_q6: ¿Puede un huésped impugnar una retención de la fianza?
home.faq_a6: Cada retención se registra en la aplicación con un motivo y una fecha. Usted y el huésped ven el mismo saldo. No hay «nunca recibí las normas» ni «no recuerdo haber aceptado eso»: todo está en un solo sitio, con marca de tiempo y visible para ambos.
home.faq_q7: ¿Y si un huésped quiere reservar otra vez?
home.faq_a7: Los huéspedes que vuelven pueden enviar una petición de fechas directamente desde la aplicación. Va al propietario o al gestor sin pasar por su número personal ni por una plataforma de terceros.
home.faq_q8: ¿Qué ocurre cuando se va un miembro del personal?
home.faq_a8: El historial de encargos, los contactos de proveedores y las notas de las propiedades se quedan en el sistema. Nada se va por la puerta con su teléfono. La siguiente persona ve la misma información desde el primer día.
home.faq_a9: Sí. El plan Particular es gratis para siempre y cubre una o dos propiedades que gestiona usted mismo. Tiene las mismas funciones —encargos, gastos, huéspedes— sin necesitar un equipo.
home.faq_a10: Cada espacio es independiente. Sus propiedades, equipo, huéspedes y finanzas solo los ven las personas que invita. Los huéspedes solo ven lo que comparte con ellos.

owners.features_access_lead: La cuenta de empresa es el centro de control de toda la operación.
owners.access_g1_desc: Gestionar cada propiedad de la empresa, actualizar detalles, asignar personas a propiedades y mantener el portafolio organizado. Añadir guías de la casa, notas e información importante para cada propiedad. Pegar una URL de exportación de calendario de Airbnb o Booking.com en una propiedad y sincronizar noches en el calendario Bookings.
owners.access_g2_desc: Gestione la organización, invite gestores, personal de campo y huéspedes, asigne propiedades concretas a personas concretas y controle quién accede a qué. Busque y elija personal por habilidades, zona, mapa y reseñas. Mantenga al equipo conectado con chat, menciones, valoraciones semanales y un ranking de la empresa.
owners.access_g3_desc: Crear, asignar, seguir y cerrar tareas a escala de la empresa. Supervisar trabajos, órdenes de servicio y proveedores, con acceso directo a proveedores por llamada, WhatsApp o LINE. Confirmar órdenes de servicio y hacer seguimiento de todo lo que ocurre en el portafolio. Abrir el calendario Bookings para estancias directas y noches importadas de canales; descargar trabajos a Google o Apple Calendar.
owners.access_g4_desc: Revise y apruebe facturas, siga el gasto de la empresa y gestione fianzas de huéspedes, incluidas retenciones con prueba fotográfica. Trabaje con 20 divisas y conversión automática.
owners.access_g5_desc: Reciba notificaciones en la aplicación y push al teléfono, genere informes y exportaciones por categoría o de toda la empresa, y siga referidos e invitaciones de equipo.
owners.access_g6_desc: Chatee con el agente en la app, o cree una clave de conexión en Ajustes y péguela en el shell de un cliente externo. El agente puede leer el equipo, las propiedades, las tareas, los encargos y las facturas, crear tareas y encargos, y marcar una tarea como hecha. Nunca recibe la clave de la base. Desconecte cuando quiera.

terms.meta_description: Terms for Pulse Flow: ops software for property teams and guests. We do not take rent or deposit payments. Software plans use the Apple App Store when live on iOS.
terms.title: Condiciones de uso
terms.intro: These Terms govern your use of Pulse Flow (the "Service") at app.pulseflow.site, www.pulseflow.site and related sites or apps. By creating an account or using the Service, you agree to these Terms.
terms.summary_li1: Pulse Flow is software for owners, managers, staff and invited guests. We help you coordinate property work. We do not rent properties, broker stays or act as landlord or host.
terms.summary_li2: We do not take or process rent, deposits or other stay money. Those payments stay between hosts and guests outside the app. Software plans (Company / Pro), when live on iOS, are purchased through the Apple App Store.
terms.summary_li3: Keep your login secure. You are responsible for activity under your account and for people you invite.
terms.summary_li4: Do not misuse the Service. We may suspend accounts that create risk for other users.
terms.what_body: Pulse Flow is a shared ops tool: properties, tasks, jobs, expense bills, contacts, team chat, guest stays, house guides, handoff notes, maintenance logs, reports and an optional AI agent. It is not a party to anyone's rental or employment relationship.
terms.what_li1: We are not a landlord, booking marketplace, escrow, bank, payment processor for stays, or employer of your staff.
terms.what_li2: Listing a property or recording a deposit in the app does not mean we rent that property or receive money for it.
terms.what_li3: Demo seats are for exploration and may be reset. Do not store production secrets only in demo.
terms.roles_intro: Cleaning and other job types are work labels, not separate account roles. Field teammates use the staff seat.
terms.roles_li1: Owner: company settings, properties, invites and software billing when live.
terms.roles_li2: Manager: day-to-day ops with the owner. Some company settings stay with the owner.
terms.roles_li3: Staff: assigned properties, tasks, jobs, team chat and expense bills.
terms.roles_li4: Guest: stay tools, house guide, Support with the host and deposit status. No team chat or master ops files.
terms.roles_li5: AI agent: optional helper for owners and managers only, scoped to their workspace.
terms.money_li1: Rent, deposits and stay fees are paid outside Pulse Flow. Guests may upload a receipt and send /deposit so the host can confirm. That is a record only.
terms.money_li2: Expense bills in the app are ops records (for example staff submitting a receipt). They are not guest checkout.
terms.money_li3: Software subscriptions, when live on iOS, are purchased and managed in the Apple App Store. They are never rent or deposit money.
terms.owner_li1: You (not Pulse Flow) are responsible for agreements, licensing, pricing, collecting money, refunds, taxes and local compliance.
terms.owner_li2: Send clear quotes with off-platform payment instructions. Confirm deposits only after you receive funds. Keep guides and handoff notes accurate; protect access codes.
terms.owner_li3: Calendar export links you paste (for example Airbnb or Booking.com) are secrets. You authorize us to fetch occupancy. Guests still book and pay on that channel. We are not affiliated with those platforms.
terms.owner_li4: Vet staff, supervise work and process guest data lawfully. Managers share ops access; company settings and some inventory controls stay with the owner as configured in the product.
terms.staff_li1: Work on assigned properties and keep status accurate. Submit expense bills with receipts when your team requires it.
terms.staff_li2: Pulse Flow is not your employer. Pay and supervision stay with the company that invited you.
terms.staff_li3: Talent directory listing is optional and can be turned off. Guest Support and deposits are for invited guests, not staff screens.
terms.staff_li4: Staff cannot create an AI agent connection key.
terms.guest_li1: Your host runs the rental and sets price, deposit rules and how you pay. Pulse Flow helps you request dates, confirm stays, view guides and chat in Support.
terms.guest_li2: Pay the host directly. Send /deposit with a receipt so they can confirm.
terms.guest_li3: Cancel from Stay home at least 3 days before check-in. Within 3 days, send /cancel in Support. Your host may cancel if a before-arrival deposit stays unpaid.
terms.guest_li4: Refunds and house rules are between you and your host. We do not hold guest funds or mediate payment disputes.
terms.agent_li1: Only owners and managers may use in-app agent chat or create a connection key for an external client.
terms.agent_li2: The agent works in your workspace under the key's scopes. It never receives your database password. Revoke a key anytime in Settings.
terms.agent_li3: You are responsible for what the agent does while the key is active. Check its work before relying on it for codes, money or guest changes.
terms.content_body: You keep ownership of data you submit. You grant us a limited license to host and process it to run and improve the Service. You are responsible for its legality and for privacy rules when inviting others.
terms.use_body: Do not reverse engineer the Service except where allowed by law, probe or disrupt systems, impersonate others, spam, upload malware, or use the Service for unlawful activity. We may remove content or suspend accounts that create risk.
terms.billing_body: Personal workspaces stay free. Companies may receive a free period while billing rolls out. When plans are live on iOS, the owner subscribes in the Apple App Store (planned Company USD 15 / month with 10 seats, then USD 2 / seat; Pro USD 9 / month for Connect your agent). Apple processes the charge; we store entitlement status. Managers, staff and guests are not billed individually. Referral rewards may unlock extended Full access as described in the app. Software fees follow App Store refund rules.
terms.s7_body: The Service is provided "as is". Pulse Flow helps you coordinate; it is not legal, tax or insurance advice, and it does not guarantee occupancy, staff performance, guest behaviour or payment between hosts and guests. To the fullest extent permitted by law, our aggregate liability is limited to software fees you paid us in the prior twelve months (or USD 100 if you paid none).
terms.s8_body: We may update these Terms, suspend access for breach or risk, or discontinue features. Continued use after we post a new "Last updated" date means you accept the update.
terms.s9_body: These Terms are governed by the laws of Thailand, except where mandatory local rights apply. Courts in Thailand have non-exclusive jurisdiction, subject to those rights. Pulse Flow operates primarily in Thailand; you remain responsible for local rental law wherever your property sits.
terms.contact_body: Pulse Flow operates app.pulseflow.site and www.pulseflow.site. For legal notices or questions: support@pulseflow.site. See also our Privacy Policy.

privacy.meta_description: How Pulse Flow collects, uses and shares account and operations data. We do not take or process rent or deposit payments.
privacy.title: Política de privacidad
privacy.intro: This policy explains how Pulse Flow collects, uses and shares information when you use app.pulseflow.site, www.pulseflow.site and related sites or apps (the "Service"). The Service is for owners, managers, staff and invited guests of rental properties.
privacy.summary_li1: We collect the account, operations and technical data needed to run the Service. We do not take or process rent or deposit payments.
privacy.summary_li2: We use it to sign you in, provide features, send the notifications you enable, keep the Service secure and improve it.
privacy.summary_li3: We share it with infrastructure providers, with teammates according to their role, with an AI agent you connect yourself, with Apple for App Store subscriptions once billing is enabled, and with authorities when the law requires.
privacy.summary_li4: We do not sell personal information, and we do not share it with advertisers.
privacy.collect_li1: Account data: name, email, role, organization and optional profile details.
privacy.collect_li2: Operations data: properties (including photos and listing links), tasks, jobs, contacts, team chat, expense bills and receipts, reports, guest stays, house guides, property details and access information, maintenance logs, and optional calendar-export links and imported occupancy.
privacy.collect_li3: Guest stay data: date requests, quotes, confirmed stays, deposit status, briefings, house-guide views and Support chat. A deposit is a record only. We do not collect card numbers for rent or deposits.
privacy.collect_li4: Technical data: device and browser type, IP address, app version, log events and the session cookies that keep you signed in.
privacy.collect_li5: Optional data: push notification tokens if you enable notifications, and cookies used by the public demo.
privacy.collect_li6: Agent data: if you use Connect your agent, we store a hash of your connection key, its label and scopes, and a log of the agent's activity in your workspace.
privacy.collect_li7: Subscription data: when App Store billing is enabled, we store subscription details on the organization, such as product and expiry date. Payment card details stay with Apple.
privacy.who_li1: Owners and managers can see the data in their company workspace, including staff work and bills, guest stays, Support chat and deposit records.
privacy.who_li2: Staff can see their profile, assigned properties, tasks, jobs, team chat and the bills they submit. Receipt and property photos you upload are stored in cloud storage.
privacy.who_li3: Guests can see their own stay, house guide, briefings, deposit record and Support chat with their host. Their host and the host's authorized team can see this data. Other guests cannot.
privacy.who_li4: Talent directory: if staff opt in, owners and managers searching in the app can see their listing, skills, location and reputation data.
privacy.who_li5: Invites: when you invite someone, we store the invite and join record tied to your company.
privacy.use_li1: Sign you in and enforce role-based access
privacy.use_li2: Provide the features you use and keep workspaces separate from each other
privacy.use_li4: Detect abuse, secure accounts and keep the Service reliable
privacy.use_li5: Improve the product using aggregated or de-identified insights
privacy.cookies_body: We use essential cookies and local storage for sign-in, language preference and demo mode. We do not use third-party advertising cookies. Blocking essential cookies may stop you from signing in.
privacy.providers_body: We use processors to run the Service: cloud hosting and content delivery (for example Vercel), database and authentication (for example Supabase), file storage for photos and receipts, email delivery, and Apple for paid subscriptions through the App Store when billing is enabled. They process data only to provide their services to us.
privacy.agent_li1: Only owners and managers can create connection keys. Staff and guests cannot.
privacy.agent_li2: We store a hash of the key, a label, its scopes and usage metadata. The full key is shown once, when you create it.
privacy.agent_li3: When the agent calls Pulse Flow, we process only the operational data its tools read or write, within your workspace and the scopes you granted. It cannot reach other companies' workspaces, take guest payments or obtain our database credentials.
privacy.agent_li4: You can revoke a key at any time in Settings. A revoked key stops working.
privacy.agent_li5: Check the agent's work before you rely on it for anything sensitive, such as access codes, money or guest changes.
privacy.agent_li6: The AI client you connect, such as your code editor or desktop assistant, processes your prompts on its own systems under its own privacy terms. Choose providers you trust.
privacy.s4_body: We keep data while your organization is active and for a reasonable period afterward for backups, dispute handling and legal compliance. We use HTTPS, access controls and role-based views, so guests, staff and owners do not see each other's private channels by default. No method is completely secure: use strong passwords or passkeys, limit invites, and protect your access codes and connection keys.
privacy.s5_li1: Update your profile and organization settings in the app.
privacy.s5_li2: Revoke agent connection keys in Settings.
privacy.s5_li3: Manage company subscriptions in the App Store (Subscriptions) once iOS billing is live.
privacy.s5_li4: To access, correct, export or delete your account or personal data, email support@pulseflow.site. We may need to verify your identity and keep limited records the law requires.
privacy.s6_body: Pulse Flow operates primarily in Thailand, where the demo launch is focused. Our providers may process data in other regions. The Service is for business and property operations and is not directed at children under 16. Do not create an account for a child under 16.
privacy.s7_body: We may update this policy and will post a new "Last updated" date. Continued use means you accept the update.
privacy.s8_body: Pulse Flow operates app.pulseflow.site and www.pulseflow.site. For privacy requests, legal notices or questions: support@pulseflow.site. See also our Terms of Service.
